pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Bubba G and The Noisemaker, your fantasy squads are an embarrassment to the beautiful game, and let me tell you why.** Look at me, Bubba G! France just got humiliated by Spain, and you're sitting there with zero points and a total of 81. You really think a couple of North African sides and the talent-fluffing Canada can save you? You're dreaming, my friend. And Mustard Boy, with a paltry 43 points, when exactly were you planning to let Brazil do the heavy lifting? You think the ghost of Ronaldo is gonna swoop in and save you? Absolutely pathetic! Now, let's talk about The Noisemaker. Rafe, your sheer chaos on this draft board is a tragedy. Germany might be your only hope, but don't flatter yourself; you know that pick was just blind luck. With 29 points, you're living proof that total ignorance doesn't substitute for grit. To Ghost Pepper Devin, you've got your 92 points, but barely leading this sad pack is like being the most competent clown in a circus. Gayden, The Backpass Assassin, you're sitting in third, but buddy, England and co. need more fight, or you’ll continue playing chase the whole tournament. So let's be real here. This is less a fantasy competition and more a clinic on how not to draft a World Cup team. Mic drop.
